extraGuidance: Non-destructive walkthrough. Never launch the run — the last step only hovers the launch button.

steps.do: Go to https://app.hai-neo.com/catalog and wait for the catalog to load.
steps.caption: Start in the Catalog — every evaluation in one place.

steps.do: Click the second Run button on the catalog to open the evaluation configuration (this only opens config, it does not launch anything), then choose the Playground project as the target.
steps.caption: Launch a red-teaming evaluation and pick the project to test.

steps.do: Type 'https://api.openai.com' into the endpoint URL field, 'gpt-4o-mini' into the model field, and 'sk-demo-key-not-real' into the API key field.
steps.caption: Point it at the model endpoint you want to probe.

steps.do: Set the evaluation time limit to 30 minutes.
steps.caption: Set how long the evaluation should run.

steps.do: Type a short system prompt describing the target assistant's persona into the system prompt field.
steps.caption: Give the target model its instructions.

steps.do: Type a brief endpoint note into the notes field.
steps.caption: Add any endpoint details worth noting.

steps.do: Click Next to continue to the Attacks page where all attack families are already selected.
steps.caption: Every attack family is included — full-coverage red-teaming.

steps.do: Click 'Review setup' to continue to the review page, then hover over the launch button WITHOUT clicking it.
steps.caption: Review everything, ready to launch.
